user.title: Connect to Vents AHU
user.description: Enter the connection details for the air handling unit. An incorrect password or device ID can cause the unit to appear unreachable.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Vents AHU
reconfigure.description: Update the connection details for this unit. Leave the password field blank to keep the current password.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the unit. Check its address, port, device ID, and password.
error.invalid_device_id: Enter a device ID with 1 to 16 ASCII characters.
error.invalid_password: Enter a password with 1 to 255 ASCII characters.
error.invalid_port: Enter a UDP port from 1 to 65535.

abort.unique_id_mismatch: The device ID does not match the configured device.

whole_temperature_required.message: Enter a whole temperature in degrees Celsius.
